productIntroInfra: We added safe USDC helpers for Arc — they avoid decimal and gas footguns — plus this test playground.
productIntroAudience: This is only a visual sample for product teams.
productIntroRepoLead: Developers go straight to the code here:
heroLede: Three LatAm fintech examples: you get paid, you collect an invoice without coming up short, and you see the send cost in dollars. One USDC balance. No wallet yet — that ships next.
convTitle: 1. Get paid or pay in USDC
convLede: Your salary lands or you pay an invoice in digital dollars. On Arc it is the same money — show a single USDC balance.
amountHint: Try “50” (salary) or “12.50” (invoice). One digital dollar = 1 USDC.
amountError: Enter a valid amount, for example 50 or 12.50 (up to 6 decimals).
balanceHintBefore: One row in the wallet. (Under the hood Arc stores the same amount two ways:
balanceHintAfter: — do not show them as two balances.)
naiveLedeAmount: You collect {amount}. An Ethereum template may think a tiny fraction is enough; on Arc you come up short if you convert wrong.
naiveLedeFallback: You collect the amount above. An Ethereum template may think a tiny fraction is enough; on Arc you come up short if you convert wrong.
naiveEthAccepts: Accepts the payment — you come up short!
naiveArcBody: Compares the full USDC value before saying OK.
naiveArcDidNotReject: Did not reject the incomplete amount
naiveFixAmount: Fix the amount above to see the comparison.
naiveDustHint: Detail: a “dust” on-chain balance can look like $0.00 USDC on screen and still exist on-chain — that is why one well-rounded balance matters.
feeTitle: 3. You send a payment: how much gas in dollars?
feeLede: You send USDC and want to know what it costs to send the transaction, in dollars. On Arc that cost (gas) is paid in USDC. If the gas price sits under the 20 Gwei minimum, the transaction can vanish without confirmation.
feeFloorHint: Arc minimum: {floor} Gwei. The cost is shown in USDC (dollars).
feeBelowFloor: The price is under the 20 Gwei minimum: on Arc this transaction may never confirm and leave no trace.
feeOkFloor: Meets the minimum: the cost is charged in USDC and the transaction can land.
